Phase 59 implemented at `9a9b0cc` on `phase/roadmap-phase-number-suffixes`.

Five sites now carry the suffix, as planned — `tagteam/roadmap.py`:
- `_PHASE_HEADING_RE` / `_PHASE_HEADING_LENIENT_RE`: `(\d+)([A-Za-z]?):`
- `_PHASE_NUM_REF_RE`, `_PHASE_NUM_SLUG_REF_RE`: suffix accepted; the
  state-format slug moved to group 3
- `_resolve_ref`: matches on the `(number, suffix)` pair
- `validate_identities`: `numbers` keyed on `(number, suffix)`, labels render
  `Phase 5b`

`RoadmapPhase.suffix` is appended after `depends_on` per your note; `number`
stays `int`. Suffixes normalize to lowercase at both parse and reference.

Reviewer notes from plan round 1, all addressed:
- positional-constructor compatibility — covered by
  `test_positional_construction_still_works`
- uppercase/lowercase equivalence, suffixed state-format references, empty
  suffixed heading diagnostics, unchanged queue ordering — one test each in
  `TestSuffixedPhaseNumbers` (11 tests, `tests/test_roadmap.py`)
- success criterion 1 refreshed in the plan doc to compare against the
  heading count rather than a fixed number, with your correction recorded:
  the round-1 figures already included the newly added Phase 59, so the
  fixed parser returns 60 here

Effect on the two roadmaps that motivated this:
- this repo: 60 headings, 60 parsed (58 before); `58a` present;
  `validate_identities` and `validate_graph` both clean; `Phase 58` and
  `Phase 58a` resolve to different phases
- bugalizer's shape is covered by `SUFFIX_ROADMAP` as a fixture, not a live
  dependency; its own roadmap is unchanged and needs no edit

Verification: focused `tests/test_roadmap.py` 83 passed while working. Full
suite is the gate's run on this submission — gate: see entry @ 9a9b0cc.

Note on the tree: `pyproject.toml` is modified but deliberately not in the
commit. That is the `3.13.0.dev0` bump from the bugalizer wheel test, and it
predates this cycle — it is in the plan cycle's recorded baseline
`dirty_paths`. It is not Phase 59 work and should land separately.

Re-submit after the round-1 gate bounce. All 3 failures were environmental —
self-inflicted by a wheel build I ran before this cycle, not by Phase 59. No
Phase 59 code changed between r1 and r2; the implementation commit is still
`9a9b0cc`.

1. `test_plugin.py::test_plugin_version_matches_pyproject`
   `assert '3.12.0' == '3.13.0.dev0'` — I had bumped `pyproject.toml` to
   `3.13.0.dev0` to build a test wheel for a local install in another
   project. The plugin manifest still reads 3.12.0, and that test asserts the
   two agree. Reverted `pyproject.toml` to 3.12.0. The bump was never Phase
   59 work; when it is made for real it has to move the plugin manifest with
   it, which is a release chore, not this phase.

2 & 3. `test_upgrade_smoke.py::test_upgrade_smoke_isolated` and
   `::test_harness_default_interpreter_reports_checkout_package`
   `uv build` had left `tagteam.egg-info/` in the checkout carrying
   `Version: 3.13.0.dev0`, so the editable install reported a version the
   checkout's `pyproject.toml` no longer claimed. Both tests check that
   agreement. Removed `build/`, `dist/`, `tagteam.egg-info/`; the file
   `tests/test_upgrade_smoke.py` then passes 7/7.

Isolation (each claim reproduced, not inferred):
- reverting `pyproject.toml` alone fixed (1) and left (2)(3) failing
- removing the build artifacts alone fixed (2)(3)
- an attempt to reproduce (2)(3) at the pre-phase commit in a worktree was
  confounded — the editable venv resolves to the main checkout — so I did not
  rely on it

Working tree is clean at `9a9b0cc` with `pyproject.toml` back at 3.12.0.
